title: Kopesh
summary: Kopesh is a blue, jackal-like Hecto-Titan. He has sharp, gold claws and has a curved, golden blade protruding from the top of its head. Kopesh wears bandages, a tattered cape and teal clothing with gold trim.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
In ancient Egypt, Kopesh was said to fly into battle on a cloud of whirling dust. He would later exit the battlefield accompanied by the howls and screams of the vanquished. [Huntik.com]

Kopesh Amulets were seen in the possession of two Rassimov's Suits along with that of Unnamed Titan 003 as they planned their attack on the Amazons. Later, Kopesh was invoked by Rassimov in the Turkish wilderness on a mission to recover the Ring of the Legendary Titan of Body, Behemoth. Kopesh, teamed with Thornment, attacked Dante Vale's Caliban and Lok Lambert's Lindorm, but Caliban defeated Kopesh by hurling Thornment at Kopesh. [Ladies' Choice]

Kopesh was later invoked by Rassimov to defend against Lok Lambert and to fight against his Freelancer. After Freelancer was sent back to his Amulet by Hopeshatter, Kopesh was defeated by Lok's new Titan, Baselaird. [Coming of Age]

Kopesh again was invoked within King Solomon's mines in the struggle for the Ring of Tao. Kopesh defeated Montehue's Tolivane and attacked Tersly's Venadek. After a heated conflict, Kopesh was defeated by Tao, who bonded with Lok. [To Be Together]

While Rassimov was secretly searching for the Necklace of Tutankhamun in the Valley of the Kings, Egypt, Kopesh's bond with Rassimov was broken by Dante's Sorrowbond spell, and his Amulet was taken into custody by Huntik Foundation agents. [Rassimov's Secret]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Kopesh is a mage [[Titan]] of the highest order. Conjuring swarms of locusts to consume his enemies or blasts of acidic black sludge to trip them up, Kopesh possesses a wide variety of powerful combat options, in addition to that, Kopesh can fly. He is the perfect partner in battle for [[Thornment]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* Kopesh's summoning command is "'''Cleave them'''".
* Kopesh's name is based on the [[wikipedia:khopesh|khopesh]], a sickle sword used by Egyptians in battle, which Kopesh bears on top of his head.
* Kopesh's appearance is based on [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anubis Anubis] whereas [[Anubian]], whose name is based off Anubis, is represented as a scarab.
